items.title: NVIDIA 'Neural Rendering, World Models and Simulation' Keynote Set for SIGGRAPH 2026
items.excerpt: NVIDIA Research and Engineering leaders Neil Ashton, Ming-Yu Liu and Edward Liu will present the sponsored keynote 'Next Era of Graphics - Neural Rendering, World Models, and Simulation' at SIGGRAPH 2026 on July 20. The talk spotlights breakthrough neural rendering techniques and AI-built world models/simulation reshaping the computer graphics and VFX pipelines filmmakers depend on.

items.title: Preview the Computer Animation Festival at SIGGRAPH in this stunning trailer
items.excerpt: befores & afters shares the trailer for the Academy Award-qualifying SIGGRAPH 2026 Computer Animation Festival, previewing the animated shorts, visual effects, scientific visualizations and digital storytelling - including Best in Show winner 'Apart' - that define the current state of CG/animation craft. A craft-showcase angle adjacent to the AI-heavy SIGGRAPH program.

items.title: Top 5 Secret A.I. Filmmaking Tools JULY 2026
items.excerpt: AI filmmaker Simon Meyer rounds up five lesser-known AI filmmaking tools for July 2026, walking through how each slots into a practical shot-by-shot generative-video workflow - a creator-medium look at the current AI film toolchain.
